TIME & DAILY ROUTINE · CLASS 41 · AGES 4–5

Weekday or Weekend?

The weekday or weekend? card from Class 41 · Time & Daily Routine — one time rule, said by YOU, tried today.

The card says

“Weekdays are Monday to Friday. The weekend is Saturday and Sunday. School days and rest days can be different.” — the weekday or weekend? card’s rule, word for word.

Try it today

sort your week into school days and home days, then name what makes the weekend different.

Keep going

This page is one of forty-one cards in Class 41 · Time & Daily Routine — the whole day, the calendar and the time words are one click away. For more day words, the First Glance Daily Routine and Times of Day sheets hold the youngest version of the same ideas.
